claim_boundary.established: The recorded local controls and 23 cross-presentation comparisons pass numerically for the explicitly listed categories and inputs.
not_claimed: A proof that every Morse diagram or category adapter is correct.
Automatic compatibility with loaded F/R payloads that use a different or undocumented basis convention.
Correctness of large Figure 8.15 E(1) evaluations outside the already recorded SU(2)_2 checkpoint.

diagnosis.first_issue: Cap handling forced F-rotations even when the capped pair was already a fusion-tree subtree. Reusing the existing subtree removes these unnecessary moves.
diagnosis.second_issue: The D(Dic_3) payload uses Frobenius-normalized SVD intertwiners. Their composite fusion-path bases are not orthonormal, while the Morse cup/cap contraction assumes an orthonormal path basis.
diagnosis.separation_check: For a three-strand RII word with a spectator, the open morphism returned to the initial fusion tree with maximum coefficient error 1.7e-16, while the old closed value failed. This localized the remaining problem to the closure/path-basis pairing rather than R or F coherence.

cross_presentation_matrix.comparison: Tham 5.11 D^-2 normalization of the corrected Yasui Figure 2 CP2(a=1) Morse presentation against the standard +1-framed CP2 presentation

singleton_braid_bridge.comparison: Native Morse fixed-label values versus the independent SU(2)_2 braid backend on every sector of the Yasui Figure 2 CP2(a=1) bridge input

normalization.activation: LoadedFRMorseAdapter applies the conversion only when payload metadata explicitly contains the documented SVD nullspace basis convention.
normalization.path_basis_gram: For left channel x and right channel y, the composite SVD-intertwiner path basis norms squared are 1/d_x and 1/d_y.
normalization.r_symbols: R blocks are unchanged because source and target trivalent spaces have the same output-channel normalization.

payload.title: Native Morse evaluator cross-category validation
payload.top_notice: The native Morse evaluator passes 23 recorded cross-presentation comparisons for SU(2)_2,3,4,5,6,8, SU(3)_2, D(A4), and D(Dic_3), in addition to its local controls. This is bounded numerical evidence, not universal certification or a theorem.
